name: Hides for the Forsaken
summary: In Tirisfal, the Forsaken gather hides to keep their bodies intact. Shelene Rhobart asks you to bring darkhound hides, duskbat wing membranes, and murloc skin.

sections.title: The Price of Undeath
sections.body: Forsaken flesh cannot mend itself. When they are wounded, the gap rots and stays open. So they stitch living tissue over their injuries to hold their forms together and keep their corpses working.

sections.title: Specialized Materials
sections.body: Each kind of material mends a different part of the body. Thick darkhound hide holds firm over broad wounds. Duskbat wing membranes are thin and pliable, so they cover faces and fingers without stiffening them. Vile Fin murloc skin lines inner membranes and sensitive places such as cheeks and mouths.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken need animal skins?
faq.answer: Forsaken skin cannot heal or grow back after an injury. They take skins and membranes from living creatures to cover wounds and slow decay.
Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworker in Tirisfal Glades. She gathers hides and other materials to help the wounded mend their rotting forms.

faq.q: Why are duskbat wing membranes specifically needed?
faq.answer: Duskbat wing membranes are thin and supple. They cover delicate places such as faces and fingers without making the skin too thick or stiff.

faq.q: What is murloc skin used for?
faq.answer: Vile Fin murloc skin lines inner membranes and delicate surfaces, including the inside of cheeks and mouths.
Darkhounds, duskbats, and Vile Fin murlocs roam Tirisfal Glades. Darkhounds and duskbats haunt the woods and roadsides, while Vile Fin murlocs gather along the northern coast and inland waterways.

faq.q: Is using animal hides common for the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Yes. The Forsaken rely on animal tissue and scavenged remains to keep going. Without replacement flesh and hides, wounds can leave bones, organs, and muscles exposed.

angles.text: As an undead, you face the burdens of the Forsaken condition. Keeping your body intact takes constant work and scavenged grafts, not natural healing.
As a tailor, you can use your stitching to bind beast membranes to decaying bodies and make garments.
